title: Yellow Yam Jamaican Chicken Bake
description: A spicy and dense Jamaican dish featuring raw vegetables and chicken, perfect for a high-protein brunch, baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven and served in a bento box.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chicken with the jerk seasoning, salt, and black pepper until the chicken is evenly coated.
In a separate bowl, toss the yellow yam, scotch bonnet pepper, red bell pepper, and onion with the olive oil, salt, and black pepper until the vegetables are evenly coated.

In a bento box, create a layer of the vegetable mixture, followed by a layer of the chicken mixture, and repeat this process until all ingredients have been used, ending with a layer of vegetables on top.
Cover the bento box with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the bento box from the oven and sprinkle the chopped cilantro over the top.
Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving.
